pixverse-mark-mask.svg.derivation: Preserves the exact d geometry of official favicon path elements 2 and 3, omits only path element 1 (the rounded-square background tile), and sets both mark fills to white for an alpha CSS mask. The source favicon remains unchanged.

hailuo-mark.svg.sourceLocation: Official page header brand anchor (<a href="/">), inline 32x32 SVG mark
hailuo-mark.svg.derivation: Preserves the exact official path d geometry and 0 0 32 32 viewBox; replaces the gradient paint with solid white for an alpha CSS mask. No background tile or new geometry.

rendering.hailuo: Use unchanged official colored favicon at existing 12px identity-mark size. Its alpha includes the white tile and a monochrome alpha mask loses spiral detail; do not ship that mask.
rendering.ltx: Unchanged official source through luminance mask; currentColor matches existing identity role; mask viewport excludes canvas margins.
rendering.pixverse: Exact official mark geometry, background tile omitted; alpha mask uses currentColor in existing identity role.
